description: AI visual inventory written before slot allocation. Index every viable candidate once; mark unusable images rejected rather than omitting silently.

scales.brandFit: 1-10: fit with this creator's visual identity
scales.heroScore: 1-10: standalone main-hero strength; an 8 remains eligible for secondary premium slots if a 9 wins hero

rules: Carousel captions are context only and never prove a child image's subject.
Text overlays reject critical slots unless the text is venue signage and allowText is explicit.
A station slot requires a visually confirmed matching station value.
When a higher hero score replaces a prior leader, the prior image remains ranked for other allowed premium slots.
No source file may be allocated twice; near-duplicate frames count as the same source moment.
